name: Dark SRF
full_name: Dark SRF superconducting radio-frequency cavity search
summary: A high-Q microwave light-shining-through-a-wall search for dark-photon mixing using two superconducting radio-frequency cavities.
detection_principle: The emitting cavity drives a dark-photon field through a barrier to regenerate in a receiving cavity; high Q enhances the stored field and weak received signal.
technologies: Microwave light shining through a wall

status.label: Prototype experiments / R&D
status.evidence: 2023 sources support the phase recorded here, rather than a real-time status of the entire project as of the access date.

timeline.event: New Exclusion Limit for Dark Photons from an SRF Cavity-Based Search (Dark SRF)

collaboration.name: Dark SRF Collaboration / project team
collaboration.participants_note: Only documented principal institutions are listed; full author and affiliation lists are in the sources. Collaborating-institution addresses are not substituted for detector locations.

results.summary: Prototype operation set kinetic-mixing limits as low as approximately 1.6×10⁻⁹.

science_scope: Produces and detects axions or dark-sector particles in the laboratory, rather than directly measuring Galactic-halo dark-matter flux. It tests interactions of dark-matter candidates; identifying a discovered particle as dark matter would also require establishing its cosmic abundance.
